decisions.reason: Premium support builds directly on the firm's round-the-clock expert service and costs little to keep beyond existing staff, so the option stays open even though its results are not observable after 2019.

The version management tool extends the firm's operations tooling and is cheap to maintain; with no evidence that its value has failed, keeping the option is better than abandoning it, though it may later be folded into the broader management tools.
Scalable agency hosting is the firm's flagship, close to its core and positioned as its strategic direction, so it is a committed exercise of the option rather than a product to abandon.
